svg.title: Vertical and horizontal window positions on a 4 by 3 grid
svg.desc: Left panel shows a 2 by 2 window can only occupy 3 distinct row positions on a 4-row input. Right panel shows it can only occupy 2 distinct column positions on a 3-column input.
svg.text: row 0, then 1, then 2 — row 3 has no room left
col 0, then 1 — col 2 has no room left
